name: UF-ega-city-square-grid
note: Square grid: everything snaps orthogonal — blocky, architectural, great for top-down maps and cities. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/ega-city-square-grid.  (sample: seed 1105)

form.subject: (top-down view:1.4) of a (walled city:1.3), streets, houses, a (castle keep:1.1)
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border, (horizon, sky:1.2)

sample_command: pixelmon '(top-down view:1.4) of a (walled city:1.3), streets, houses, a (castle keep:1.1), ega_art, EGA 16-color pixel art, scene background, strategy game, 1980s DOS game' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora ega-art-v2.safetensors --lora-strength 0.8 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border, (horizon, sky:1.2)' --style scene --out 320x200 --palette EGA --despeckle 0 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --thin-lines 2 --pixel-angles 1.5 --angle-grid square --seed 1105
